read_only_board_snapshot.interpretation_limit: Cumulative counters prove that CPU 7 still executes timer, RCU, and kernel-worker work, but they do not align any specific kernel event to the preserved slow ticks. The existing trace therefore cannot distinguish scheduled thread compute from interrupt, softirq, or preemption time.

selected_falsifier.name: PAIRED_STAGE_WALL_AND_THREAD_CPU_TIME_ATTRIBUTION
selected_falsifier.reason: Linux thread CPU time excludes time when the policy thread is not executing and IRQ-time accounting is enabled. Recording paired wall and thread CPU durations around the exact stage call can distinguish a slow computation from time stolen by kernel or scheduler work without changing policy numerics or boot state.
selected_falsifier.population: one paced 250-calibration plus 2048-locomotion no-device chain using the already-derived lower-cond0 graph
measurements: per-tick voluntary and involuntary context-switch deltas
per-tick minor and major page-fault deltas
start/end CPU7 softirq and interrupt counters

rejected_immediate_actions.boot_change: The current evidence identifies incomplete housekeeping isolation as a competing cause but does not attribute the measured p99 miss to it. Do not reboot or change boot parameters before paired timing speaks; this kernel also lacks CONFIG_NO_HZ_FULL.
rejected_immediate_actions.context_route_retry: The valid corrected screen permanently closed that optimization under its frozen decision rule. The attribution population carries zero reserve selection weight and cannot reverse the closure.
rejected_immediate_actions.policy_change_or_training: T247 outputs are exact and no policy behavior defect is implicated; training is unearned.
rejected_immediate_actions.native_policy_extension: The repository escalation rule permits only the servo transaction to move native after a 20 ms loop miss; it does not authorize a native policy host.
